name: gizza-ai/list-set-diff
summary: Compare two lists and show only-in-A, only-in-B, and shared items.

tool.description: Compare two lists as sets and report which items are only in list A, only in list B, and shared by both — each with a count, plus a totals line (including the union size). Items are split by `separator` (newline by default, or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe/space). Normalization options: `ignore_case`, `trim` whitespace, `ignore_blank` empty items, `dedupe` repeats within a list (set semantics), and `ignore_leading_zeros` (007 == 7). `sort` orders each section (input/asc/desc). Great for diffing email lists, IDs, SKUs, or any two collections.

dedupe.description: Collapse repeated items within each result section (set semantics). Turn off to keep every occurrence. Default true.

ignore_blank.description: Drop empty items (e.g. blank lines). Default true.

ignore_case.description: Compare items case-insensitively (Apple == apple). Default false.

ignore_leading_zeros.description: Treat leading zeros as insignificant so 007 and 7 match — handy for numeric IDs. Default false.

list_a.description: The first list ("A"). Items separated per the `separator` param — one per line by default.

list_b.description: The second list ("B"), same format as list_a.

separator.description: How items are split within each list: 'newline' (default, one per line), 'comma', 'tab', 'semicolon', 'pipe', or 'space'.

sort.description: Ordering of each result section: 'input' (default, first-seen order), 'asc' (A→Z), or 'desc' (Z→A).

trim.description: Strip leading/trailing whitespace from each item before comparing. Default true.
